design_note: Uses three strictly atomic reference facts (23-year-old Black man, daily hydroxyurea capsules, and a rigid very painful erection lasting 5 hours today) with zero apostrophe contractions ('Im', 'I am', 'I have', 'it is'), an exact 7-word vs 7-word span swap, and zero banned diagnosis words ('priapism' and 'sickle' omitted from prompt texts). Under Rule A first choice and Rule D, changing 5-hour painful persistence in f3 to a morning erection that went down in 5 minutes shifts right care cleanly from emergency hospital decompression (level 4) to home self-care (level 1) with zero stated negatives.
